answer: Each identity must forge a distinct artifact and file it on a public trellis registry, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a sparrow auditor checks one filing: forge log, maker key, and trellis entry must match, or the bond burns. The k-th fake costs 40+6(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented artifact names the lender key, so lender and renter burn together. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the full share.
